//: Merge into your user settings.json (Windows: C:\Users\<you>\.claude\settings.json). First copy enforcement/hooks/index_guard.py and enforcement/hooks/sessionstart_index.py to C:\Users\<you>\.claude\hooks\. WARNING: replace C:\Users\<you> with your literal home path -- Claude Code does NOT expand %USERPROFILE% in hook commands, and an unresolvable script path makes python exit 2, which BLOCKS all matched tool calls. On Windows the interpreter is `python`, not `python3`. Prefer running install/install.ps1, which writes the expanded path for you.
